ceiling.note: Hobby extra credits cost $5 per 1,000 ($0.005 each), above the plan's $0.0038; 2 credits per block.

pricing.note: 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up; a search with no results reported 0 credits live (2026-11-25). Hobby is $19 for 5,000 credits; Standard is about $0.001 per credit. Scraping results adds scrape credits; the gov category adds none.

verification.note: Every replayable vector passed live in both runtimes (registry/conformance/live/firecrawl-2026-11-25.json); the 402 and 500 vectors stay offline. Seen live: data.metadata.creditsUsed and data.metadata.scrapeId on every scrape, a target 404 as statusCode 404 charged 1 credit.

pricing.note: 1 credit per returned document, including target 403 and 404 pages; a scrape that returns no document is free. PDF parsing, on by default, adds 1 credit per PDF page; the bound covers one credit per URL.

Kept 2026-11-25. The account's credit-usage shows planCredits 1000 (the Free plan's monthly credits; coupon credits are excluded) and queue-status shows maxConcurrency 250, a team-specific concurrency above every plan's. Responses carry no rate-limit headers and the per-minute limit is not exposed, so it was not probed. Consumers obey the strictest documented limit (Free: 10 a minute, 2 concurrent).
The credit price depends on the plan, by up to about 4x; the Hobby list price is used.

A target 403 or 404 comes back as a document with metadata.statusCode and is charged; it is reported failed and billable (a 404 charged 1 credit live on 2026-11-25). A document without statusCode is treated the same way.

Resolved 2026-11-25: the scrape reference documents no credit count or request id, but every live scrape carried data.metadata.creditsUsed and data.metadata.scrapeId (smoke check and live conformance). Both are read; they stay listed here because they are undocumented.

Billing docs (read 2026-11-25): PDF parsing, on by default, adds 1 credit per PDF page. The bound counts one credit per URL, so a PDF's reported credits can exceed it; callers that reserve spend must scale for documents.
